Glad you like it! Quick recap of what's in [index.html](index.html):

- **The model**: marble plinth, chamfered mausoleum body with four pishtaq portals and two-story niches, ribbed onion dome with lotus petals and gold finial, four chhatris, four 3-balcony minarets, the red sandstone mosque and jawab, the Great Gate, charbagh gardens with cypress avenues, real-time reflecting pool, the Yamuna behind, and a flock of birds circling the dome.
- **Camera system**: orbit (drag/scroll/pan) plus a fly mode on <kbd>F</kbd> with WASD/QE and Shift-boost.
- **The 20-second showcase**: <kbd>Space</kbd> or the button — fade in from black, low skim over the reflecting pool with the title card, crane up around the west minaret, crest behind the dome over the river, wide eastern reveal, then a lens-tightening settle into the classic three-quarter view with the end card. Esc skips.

To view it, just open the preview panel or serve the folder (`python -m http.server 8741`) and visit `localhost:8741`. One note: I left a small `window.__taj` debug hook at the bottom of the file from verification — harmless, but feel free to ask me to strip it if you want the file clean.
